blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The local government of Bacoor City in Cavite wants an ordinance to penalize prank callers who abuse its 161 emergency hotline, following reports that thousands of calls to the service were hoaxes. During a quarterly meeting of the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (DRRMO), Mayor Strike Revilla was told that out of more than 8,000 calls received by the 161 hotline, at least 5,000 were prank calls. “It is disheartening to learn that our 161 emergency hotline receives thousands of prank calls.
